topic: Conservative radius-padded bounding-sphere frustum culling versus center-point culling
topic_zh: 保守包围球半径外扩视锥裁剪与中心点误裁对比
scope: Deterministic unit-normal frustum-plane signed distance n·c + d >= -r, 72-point boundary sampling comparison and Node CPU solving. No StopThePop or FlashGS CUDA kernel execution.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Unit-normal plane dot product n·c + d >= -r versus 72-point perimeter circle sampling per sphere, not CUDA tile sorting.

protocol.function: unit inward plane normal n → signed distance s = n·c + d → keep if s >= -r → 0 edge pops

robustness.name: Sampled camera pan angles retain zero false-negative edge pops

Conservative 3D Gaussian and particle bounding-sphere culling

not_for: StopThePop per-pixel hierarchical tile depth sorting
Hardware depth-buffer occlusion culling behind walls
